web.ai.browser: External models tag while a TwimShelf tab is open. Images and the tagging prompt are sent to the selected service.
web.ai.externalFooter: Enter the address of an OpenAI-compatible service. A service without an API key can use its first model. Keys are stored on this server and stay out of sync.
web.ai.local: Manage models stored on the server. Tagging in this app uses an external model service.
web.ai.otherTab: Another TwimShelf tab is handling tagging. Try again in a moment.
web.cookie.footer: Copy auth_token and ct0 from the x.com cookies in your browser’s developer tools. The server stores them without syncing them to other devices.
web.wipe.cleanup: The library was erased. Some uploaded or temporary files could not be removed.
welcome.p1.body.desktop: Media on the Browse page appear in a random order every time the app opens. Click the reshuffle button anytime to re-randomize.
welcome.p1.body.mobile: Media on the Browse page appear in a random order every time the app opens. Pull down on the home feed or double-tap Browse in the navigation bar to refresh.
welcome.p1.title: A Fresh Feed Every Launch
welcome.p2.title: Fluid Album Grid Zoom
welcome.p3.body: In Browse, double-tap or double-click the text box in Quick Download to paste automatically, or open Settings → Downloads to import JSON for batch downloading.
welcome.p3.title: Quick Download & JSON Batch Import
welcome.p4.body: Browse online models on Hugging Face, or connect an external API to tag your media.
welcome.p4.title: Download AI Models for Auto-Tagging
welcome.p5.body: Besides adding your own tags manually, you can also approve AI-suggested tags.
welcome.p5.title: Three Tag Origins: AI, Mine & Common
welcome.p6.body: Add any filter tokens to find what you're looking for, and use a leading minus (-) to exclude items.
welcome.p6.title: Multi-Faceted Token Search
welcome.p7.title: Decentralized Local Network Sync
welcome.p8.body: Quickly import media from local folders, archives, photo libraries, or legacy collections, and export .tlpack cold backups or filtered search results anytime.
welcome.p8.title: Full Import & Portable Backups
windows.cookie.footer: Used to download posts from locked accounts. Sign in to x.com in a browser and copy auth_token and ct0 from the cookies in its developer tools. Kept sealed in the data folder on this computer only, never synced.
windows.folders.empty: No folders yet. Make one with Ctrl+Shift+N or New Folder at the top right, or add media to a new folder from a grid.
